name: Fillo
description: Create and publish forms, read responses, and manage uploads and webhooks through Fillo's MCP server.

FILLO_TOKEN.description: Fillo CLI login token for authenticated operations; optional when a saved CLI login or another supported credential is available.

FILLO_API_KEY.description: Scoped Fillo project API key for private response and management operations; permissions depend on the tool.

FILLO_PK.description: Fillo publishable key for the active project; workspace provisioning can save one automatically.
